targets.expr:
max by (severity, name, message) (ceph_health_detail{job=~"$job"} > 0)
or on() label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0),
  "severity", "OK", "", ""), "name", "HEALTH_OK", "", ""),
  "message", "Không có cảnh báo", "", "")

panels.title: OSD Used Class $class

targets.expr:
topk(1,
  max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_stat_bytes_used{job=~"$job"})
  / max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_stat_bytes{job=~"$job"}) * 100
  * on(ceph_daemon) group_left()
  max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_metadata{device_class=~"$class", job=~"$job"})
)

bottomk(1,
  max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_stat_bytes_used{job=~"$job"})
  / max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_stat_bytes{job=~"$job"}) * 100
  * on(ceph_daemon) group_left()
  max by (ceph_daemon) (ceph_osd_metadata{device_class=~"$class", job=~"$job"})
)

panels.description: Lặp theo biến OSD Class: OSD dùng nhiều nhất / ít nhất của từng device class.

panels.title: Resource Cluster with HA Groups

targets.expr:
label_replace(pve_ha_state{state="online", id=~"node/.*", job=~"$job"}, "host", "$1", "id", "node/(.*)")
and on(job) count by (job) (pve_ha_groups_custom_info{job=~"$job"})

panels.description: Cột HA và HA Groups chỉ hiện khi cluster đang chọn có HA group / node-affinity rule (pve_ceph_extra_exporter đọc groups.cfg / rules.cfg).
